parsed.root_cause: EBS CSI 驅動程式無法正確釋放已掛載的磁碟，導致 PersistentVolumeClaim 無法完成綁定並引發調度失敗
evidence: K8s events 顯示多個 PVC 因 'persistentvolume ... is still attached to node' 而報錯 VolumeFailedDelete
K8s events 顯示 Pod 因 'Operation cannot be fulfilled on persistentvolumeclaims ... the object has been modified' 而 FailedScheduling
告警顯示 KubeControllerManager 和 KubeScheduler 從 Prometheus target discovery 消失，暗示控制平面組件可能因資源爭用或 CSI 控制器阻塞而異常
